name: @rtepl/pale-wasm
author: Harsh Joshi
description: WebAssembly package that compiles, inspects and reviews Pale Workspace documents without reading files or running tools.

scripts.build: node scripts/wasm-pack.mjs build --release --target bundler --out-dir dist --out-name pale_wasm --no-pack -- --locked && node scripts/finalize-dist.mjs
scripts.bench:build: node scripts/wasm-pack.mjs build --release --target nodejs --out-dir target/wasm-pack-bench-node --out-name pale_wasm --no-pack -- --locked
scripts.test:abi: node scripts/wasm-pack.mjs build --release --target nodejs --out-dir target/wasm-pack-node --out-name pale_wasm -- --locked && node tests/native_abi.mjs ./target/wasm-pack-node/pale_wasm.js ./tests/fixtures/cross-leaf.v1
scripts.test: npm run test:wasm && npm run test:abi && npm run test:package --
